name: io.github.monkeywave/frida-mobile-mcp
title: Frida Mobile MCP
description: Mobile Frida MCP Server - AI-powered mobile app exploration and testing via Frida instrumentation

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_DEVICE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Frida device ID to use (e.g. emulator-5554 or a USB serial). Can also be set with --device.

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_ALLOW_CUSTOM_SCRIPTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to enable execution of custom Frida scripts (execute_script and custom hook_function handlers). Disabled by default.

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_MEMORY_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to enable the write_memory tool. Disabled by default for safety.

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_REMOTE
environmentVariables.description: host[:port] of a remote frida-server to add as a remote device at startup (port defaults to 27042).

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_SCHEMA_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool schema profile. "compact" shortens tool schemas and descriptions for clients with small context windows.

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of characters in a single tool response; longer output is truncated.

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required by HTTP clients. Only used with --transport http (required when --host is not loopback); unused for the default stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_RUNTIME
environmentVariables.description: Frida script runtime to use for injected agents.

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to "1" to enable debug logging on stderr. Can also be set with --debug.

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_BRIDGES_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory with prebuilt Java/ObjC bridge bundles (defaults to dist/bridges inside the package)

environmentVariables.name: FRIDA_MCP_COMPILER_PROJECT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory for the frida.Compiler project used to compile ES module scripts

environmentVariables.name: FRITAP_AGENT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a friTap fritap_agent.js bundle for capture_tls (otherwise the installed friTap Python package or a pinned download is used)

environmentVariables.name: FRITAP_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: friTap release tag to download when no local agent is found (default v2.5.2)
